elements.content: A little girl named Little Red Riding Hood goes to visit her sick grandmother. In the forest, she meets a wolf and tells it where her grandmother lives. The wolf comes to grandma’s house first and eats grandma. Then he wears grandma’s glasses and clothes, and lies in her bed. When Little Red Riding Hood arrives, she notices her “grandmother” looks strange. So she asks, “Grandma, why is your mouth so big?” The wolf answers, “I eat little girls with this mouth.” Then the wolf runs after Little Red Riding Hood and is ready to eat her. Luckily, a hunter passes through the house. He shoots the wolf and saves Little Red Riding Hood and her grandma.

elements.content:

Good morning to you, good morning to you.

child_list.content: 小红帽
child_list.name: 题目

child_list.content: 一个名叫小红帽的小女孩去探望她生病的外婆。在森林中，她遇到了一只狼，并告诉了狼她外婆的住处。狼先到了外婆的家并吃掉了外婆。然后，它戴上外婆的眼镜，穿上外婆的衣服，躺在她的床上。当小红帽到达时，她注意到她的“外婆”看起来很奇怪。所以她问：“外婆，你的嘴为什么这么大？”狼回答：“我用这张嘴吃小女孩。”然后狼追上了小红帽，准备吃掉她。幸运的是，一位猎人路过这户人家。他射杀了狼并救了小红帽和她的外婆。

child_list.content: 你好，你好，你好
child_list.name: 题目

child_list.content:
你好，你好，你好。嗨，嗨，嗨。

早上好，早上好。

美好的一天，我们出去玩吧。

下午好，下午好。

美好的一天，让我们吹口哨吧。

晚上好，晚上好。

美好的夜晚，让我们在月光下跳舞吧。
